description:
Brand introduction: QuickDNA is a leading brand in the field of DNA testing, offering a diverse range of high-quality and accurate DNA testing products. Our brand is committed to providing reliable and accessible DNA testing solutions to individuals seeking to explore their ancestry, understand their genetic traits, and make informed health-related decisions. At QuickDNA, we prioritize customer satisfaction, data privacy, and cutting-edge technology to deliver an exceptional DNA testing experience.

Product description: Our product lineup includes a wide variety of DNA testing kits that cater to different needs and interests. These kits are designed to be user-friendly, non-invasive, and provide detailed insights into an individual's genetic makeup. Some of our popular DNA testing products include:

  1. Ancestry DNA Test: Uncover your ethnic origins and trace your family heritage through an extensive global database of genetic markers.

  2. Health DNA Test: Discover valuable information about potential genetic health risks, carrier status for certain conditions, and personalized health recommendations.

  3. Traits DNA Test: Learn about fascinating genetic traits you possess, such as eye color, hair type, and more.

  4. Paternity DNA Test: Establish accurate and legally admissible paternity results for peace of mind or legal purposes.

USP (Unique Selling Point): QuickDNA stands out from its competitors through the following unique selling points:

  1. Precision and Accuracy: Our DNA testing processes are conducted using state-of-the-art technology and rigorous quality control measures, ensuring highly accurate and reliable results.

  2. Privacy and Data Protection: We prioritize the security and confidentiality of our customers' genetic data, employing industry-standard encryption and data anonymization protocols.

  3. Diverse Product Range: QuickDNA offers a comprehensive selection of DNA testing kits, catering to various interests, from ancestry exploration to health and wellness insights.

  4. Customer Support: Our dedicated support team is available to assist customers throughout their DNA testing journey, from purchasing the kit to interpreting the results.

Payment terms: For a seamless shopping experience, QuickDNA offers two convenient payment methods:

  1. PayPal: Customers can make secure payments using their PayPal accounts, ensuring fast and hassle-free transactions.

  2. Bank Transfer (Virement): We also accept direct bank transfers, providing an alternative payment option for those who prefer this method.

Other information:

  • Shipping: We offer worldwide shipping to ensure customers from different regions can access our products easily.
  • DNA Sample Collection: Our testing kits include easy-to-follow instructions for collecting DNA samples, which can be done at home, eliminating the need for inconvenient laboratory visits.
  • Turnaround Time: Once we receive the DNA samples at our laboratory, customers can expect to receive their results within the specified timeframe, which varies depending on the type of test ordered.
  • Legal Compliance: QuickDNA adheres to all relevant regulations and standards in the DNA testing industry to maintain the highest level of integrity and accuracy.

At QuickDNA, we are committed to empowering individuals with valuable genetic insights while maintaining the highest level of professionalism, privacy, and customer satisfaction. Join us on this exciting journey of self-discovery through DNA testing.

Welcome and thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

 

1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

 

2. Liability

Any disparagement of the brand, its parent company, or its affiliates, by you in a direct or indirect manner, for the duration of the program and for a period of 10 years after the date of termination of the program obliges you to pay the sum of €100,000 as compensation.

 

3. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on the dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.

 

4. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.

 

5. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.

 

6. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.

 

7. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).

 

8. Ordering free products

Any free product order commits you to promote it, for example by a YouTube video, a blog article or a publication on social networks within 7 days of receipt of the product. Once this 7-day period is over, each day the promotion is late in publishing will result in a €50 penalty, which will either be deducted from your future earnings or paid for by yourself via bank transfer.

If you still have not completed the promotion within 28 days of receiving the product(s), the affiliate program will be deemed terminated on your initiative. You will be required to pay the public price for all the products received, as well as the fixed cancellation fine of €1,400.

If you completed the promotion and then withdrew it for any reason, without our brand's prior approval, the affiliate program will be deemed terminated at your initiative. You will be required to pay the public price for all the products received, as well as the fixed cancellation fine of €1,400.

 

9. Non-competition clause

For the duration of the affiliate program and until one year after the termination of the program, you will be prohibited from promoting products that compete with those of our brand. Failure to comply with this clause exposes you to a fixed fine of €20,000 for each promotion carried out for a competing brand.

 

10. Promotion deadline

After signing up for the affiliate program, even if you did not order free products, you have 28 days to promote our brand. If this is not done within 28 days, the program will be considered terminated by your initiative.

 

11. Termination

Any termination of the program by the brand or the affiliate is subject to compensation of €1,400 towards the other party, as well as payment by the affiliate for the products received.

This amount may be subtracted from the affiliate's earnings, even if the earnings have already been paid to the affiliate, if the termination is made at the brand's initiative.

 

Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to affiliation@ferberenterprises.com for support.
